::: {.v-top}
### Better Outcomes. Better Schools.
<br>
This website provides free information and resources to help parents, educators, and community members collaborate to improve practices across NY public schools. We want people to share and understand issues from all perspectives so we can advocate together for effective change—including evidence-based practices, strong teacher support, and meaningful family engagement—to improve outcomes for all students.

A Least Restrictive Environment is only possible when teachers are supported with quality programs, reusable scaffolds, and accommodations. FAPE is not optional. Every student deserves the opportunity to learn to read and write, and every teacher deserves a safe, supportive workplace.

If you share our commitment to improving public school practices—for the sake of better outcomes for all students and supporting teachers in achieving them—we welcome your ideas, feedback, and contributions.
:::
